name: DoTA
summary: 面向交通异常检测的驾驶视频数据集，标注道路异常、事故和相关时序片段，用于评测模型对罕见危险状态演化的识别能力。
summaryEn: A driving-video dataset for traffic-anomaly detection, annotating road anomalies, crashes, and related temporal segments to evaluate recognition of rare hazardous state evolution.
scale: Traffic anomaly video clips with temporal anomaly annotations
scaleZh: 带时序异常标注的交通异常视频片段
licenseZh: 数据集条款需进一步核查
access: Official GitHub repository provides dataset and benchmark resources
accessZh: 官方 GitHub 仓库提供数据集和基准资源
verdict: 交通异常和事故时序诊断数据
verdictEn: Temporal diagnostics for traffic anomalies and accidents
wmNote: 罕见异常片段适合检验世界模型是否能识别危险状态转折，但不适合作为常规驾驶动力学主训练集。
wmNoteEn: Rare anomaly clips are useful for testing whether world models identify hazardous state transitions, but are not ideal as a primary normal-driving dynamics corpus.
